name: Enticho/Gendebta Truck Strike
detail: ENDF-attributed drone strike hit two Isuzu trucks near Enticho and Gendebta in northern Tigray, killing one and injuring another. Ethiopian officials did not confirm responsibility.

name: North Shewa Household Strike
detail: Drone strike on a residence in North Shewa zone killed a pregnant woman, her six-year-old daughter, and a young man, as documented by Human Rights Watch's World Report 2026.

name: East Gojjam Drone Strike
detail: Drone strike killed 16 people including children and injured 10 others in East Gojjam zone, one of the deadliest single strikes recorded in the March 2026 Amhara reporting window.

name: ENDF South Gondar Counteroffensive
detail: ENDF deployed a reported ~20,000 troops to reassert control over South Gondar zone ahead of the June general election, following sustained Fano offensives on approach roads to Bahir Dar.

name: ENDF Engagement at Shererina
detail: Federal forces engaged TPLF's 'Army 70' unit near Shererina in an ~11-hour battle involving drones, heavy artillery, and mechanized units — the most serious clash since the 2022 Pretoria agreement.

name: Dual Drone Strikes on Mekelle
detail: Two drone strikes hit Mekelle in the early hours of Aug 20 — one on the Hawelti Sub-City residential area near St. Mary Church, another near Mekelle University — wounding 13 people. TPLF attributed the strikes to the federal government; the ENDF did not immediately comment.

name: Merewa Secondary School Strike
detail: Drone strike hit Merewa Secondary School in Raya Alamata district using a reported Turkish-made platform; Tigrayan military and the local governor gave conflicting accounts of who was killed.

name: Repeated Follow-On Strikes, Raya Alamata
detail: Additional drone strikes reported across Raya Alamata district the same morning as the Merewa school strike.
